experiment_context: Sequence 2 Laboratory Monster · Candidate X Extraction & Exteriority

recorded_observations.summary: Candidate D (Inline Non-Modal Membrane) remains a viable ergonomic alternative to Candidate X's modal presentation.
recorded_observations.detail: While Candidate X solves the quotient collapse via a modal dialog (#loomReentryModal), an inline expansion control (e.g. secondary action chip inside composer or toggle above chat input) could enforce the same finite quotient (A=1 for 1 turn, then A=0) with substantially reduced cognitive disruption.
recorded_observations.falsifier: Mobile A/B tournament comparing completion speed and drop-off between modal dialog and inline chip.

recorded_observations.summary: Browser Network Disconnect during Re-entry Membrane Confirmation
recorded_observations.detail: If network connectivity drops after the operator confirms the membrane dialog but before the request reaches the server, the arming lease active=true may persist in memory while the user sees a network error, potentially leaking carriage on subsequent offline recovery turns.
recorded_observations.falsifier: Offline network simulation during membrane arming transition in Puppeteer/Playwright.

recorded_observations.summary: Marrowline Attachment Retry vs Governed Carriage Composition
recorded_observations.detail: PR #1433 introduces exact attachment replay for ordinary chat via Red Deer non-enumerable memory. When Candidate X and PR #1433 compose in Sequence 3, we must verify that retrying a failed ordinary message does not accidentally re-arm or re-attach Loom governed files.
recorded_observations.falsifier: Integration test exercising #1433 retry button immediately following a REST governed turn.

recorded_observations.detail: Governed continuation lease is currently turn-bounded (1 turn). In enterprise or multi-user environments, time-bounded expiration (e.g. 5 minutes of idle time after DONE) may be required alongside turn bounds.
recorded_observations.falsifier: Automated timeout test where modal confirms arming but idle delay of 300s revokes active status.
